description:
Retrieve the list of principals that are assigned to the directory role.  You can use both the object ID and template ID of the directoryRole with this API. The template ID of a built-in role is immutable and can be seen in the role description on the Microsoft Entra admin center. For details, see Role template IDs.

TIP: Lists members of a specific directory role. Use this to audit who has Global Admin, Exchange Admin, etc. Returns user and servicePrincipal objects.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (5-15) so responses fit the model context. Use @odata.nextLink from the response for more rows.

name: list-role-members
